CENTRAL POLICE Station.
April 17 1921
REPORT ON The Bolshevist Movement as seen from Shanghai
since January 1, 1921.
Made by D. S. I. Sullivan Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Sir,
The decision arrived at by the Chinese Government in
September last to cancel the extraterritorial rights of
Russians and the consequent loss of authority by the Russian
Consul-General, together with the increase in the numbers of
Russians coming to Shanghai has made it increasingly difficult
to follow the activities of people connected with Bolshevism.
In September 1920 a delegation from the Russian Far
Eastern Government headed by a man named Yourin arrived in
Peking. Since their arrival the members of the delegation
have been endeavouring to conclude a trade agreement between
China and Soviet Russia and to get the Chita Government offi-
cially recognized but, so far, without success.
It is thought by anti-Bolshevik Russians that the
members of the Yourin mission are also in China for the purpose
of spreading their Bolshevistic doctrine and also to discover
who the leading anti-Bolsheviks in China are.
It would be difficult for a foreigner to carry on
open propaganda in China without quickly becoming known to the
Chinese Authorities. There is a rumour, however, that
Chinese emissaries are being sent from Moscow over the
Manchurian border into China but so far as can be ascertained
none of these has turned up in Shanghai.
As to what success they are having amongst the
Chinese population it must be remembered that the vast majori-
ty of the people, including the soldiers and police, are
illiterate, so that propaganda in the form of literature is

关于自1921年1月1日以来从上海视角观察布尔什维克运动的报告。
由副督察长苏利文（D. S. I. Sullivan）撰写，经刑事情报处处长转呈。

先生，

中国政府去年九月决定取消俄国人的治外法权，以及随之而来的俄国总领事权威的丧失，加上来沪俄国人数的增加，使得追踪与布尔什维克主义有关人员的活动变得日益困难。

1920年9月，一个由名为尤林（Yourin）的人率领的俄罗斯远东政府代表团抵达北京。自抵达以来，代表团成员一直努力促成中国与苏维埃俄国之间的贸易协定，并寻求赤塔（Chita）政府获得官方承认，但迄今为止未获成功。

反布尔什维克的俄国人认为，尤林使团成员在华的目的还包括传播其布尔什维克主义学说，并查明中国主要的反布尔什维克人士是谁。

外国人在中国进行公开宣传而不很快为中国当局所知是困难的。然而，有谣言称莫斯科正派遣中国代理人越过满洲边境进入中国，但据查，这些人中尚无一人出现在上海。

至于他们在中国民众中取得的成效，必须记住，绝大多数人，包括士兵和警察，都是文盲，因此以文学形式进行的宣传

The visiting of teashops, theatres, and other public places and expounding a doctrine is so public and so easily detected that the Chinese Authorities would not have much difficulty in putting it down. Bolshevist and Socialist literature is believed to be circulated rather extensively amongst the students in Peking and in the treaty ports and it is this class of the population which would most easily become imbued with Bolshevik ideas. In this connection it may be noted that in February last a book store in the French Concession was raided by the French Police and several volumes of half a dozen socialist books by various authors of various nationalities were seized. It may also be noted that during the last three years forty six different volumes of socialistic Communistic and Bolshevistic books, periodicals, etc. have come into the hands of the Police. However, the fact that most of the colleges are in or near the treaty ports where police supervision is strictest, renders the open circulation of this class of literature very difficult and if the Post Office censorship were strictly enforced it would be almost impossible.

A notorious Russian propagandist named Stopany who taught Chinese students the Esperanto language and at the same time is believed to have instilled Bolshevist ideas into their minds, committed suicide last month.

There was a suspicion that Chinese Bolsheviks would organize a demonstration during the recent Chinese New Year

并无多大用处。走访茶馆、剧院和其他公共场所并宣讲学说，这种做法过于公开且极易被察觉，中国当局在镇压此类活动方面不会有多大困难。据信，布尔什维克和社会主义文献在北京及各通商口岸的学生中流传较广，而这一阶层的人口最容易受到布尔什维克思想的浸染。在此方面，值得注意的是，去年二月，法租界的一家书店遭到法国警察搜查，没收了半打由不同国籍作者撰写的社会主义书籍共数卷。另需指出的是，在过去三年中，共有四十六种不同的社会主义、共产主义和布尔什维克书籍、期刊等落入警方手中。然而，由于大多数学院位于或靠近警察监管最严格的通商口岸，此类文献的公开流通非常困难，如果邮局审查制度得到严格执行，这几乎是不可能的。

一名臭名昭著的俄国宣传家斯托帕尼（Stopany），他教授中国学生世界语，同时被认为向他们的头脑中灌输布尔什维克思想，于上月自杀身亡。

holidays, but it came to nothing.

Some of the leaders of the Southern Government are cre-
dited with holding Bolshevist opinions and the recent utteran-
ces of one Chen To Seu( 陳獨秀 ), Minister of Education in
that party, and formerly a professor at Peking University, who
has been preaching the doctrine of free love and deriding the
belief in filial piety, a belief which the Chinese have held
from time immemorial, proves that he at any rate is helping
the Bolshevist cause. He, however, is a man who is generally
discredited and by none more than the Cantonese in Shanghai,
and it is thought that he, like most of the Southern leaders,
having forfeited the trust of the educated and middle class
people, is now endeavouring by these means to enlist a
following from amongst the very poor and very ignorant, but
it is believed that the people of Kwangtung province generally
are showing a decided objection to Bolshevism.

Amongst the various trade societies which have been
formed in Shanghai recently there are no doubt some of the
leaders who have extreme ideas, but as long as the Chinese
Authorities can ensure a plentiful supply of rice at a reasona-
ble price there is reason to believe that the innate customs
and characteristic of the Chinese people would prevent them
ever becoming militant Bolsheviks.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Sullivan

南方政府的一些领导人被认为持有布尔什维克观点。该党派的教育部长陈独秀（Chen To Seu），曾任北京大学教授，他一直宣扬自由恋爱学说并嘲弄孝道信仰——这是中国人自古以来的信念——这一事实证明，他至少在帮助布尔什维克事业。然而，他是一个普遍失去信誉的人，在上海的广东人尤其不信任他。人们认为，他和大多数南方领导人一样，因失去了受过教育的中产阶级人士的信任，现在正试图通过这些手段从极度贫困和无知的人群中招募追随者，但据信广东省民众总体上对布尔什维克主义表现出明显的反感。

在上海最近成立的各种同业公会中，无疑有一些领导人持有极端思想，但只要中国当局能确保以合理价格充足供应大米，就有理由相信，中国人民的风俗习惯和特性将防止他们成为好战的布尔什维克分子。

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
April 17 1921

REPORT ON Political situation as seen from Shanghai since
January 1 1921.

Made by D. S. I. Sullivan Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence

Sir,

Despite changes which have taken place in the
Southern Government, and a Presidential Mandate issued in
October 1920 declaring the unification of the North and South
peace seems to be almost as far off as ever.

Since the late Li Shun, Tuchun of Kiangsu, committed
suicide in October 1920 a short time after his appointment as
Northern Peace Delegate in succession to Wang Ih Tang (王揖唐)
who gave up his post in August 1920 after the defeat of the
Anfu Party by the Chilites, no formal meetings between repre-
sentatives of the Central and Southern Governments have been
held.

The latest development in Canton is the election of
Dr. Sun Yat-sen as President of the so-called Southern Republic
and in this many people, including influential Cantonese, see
hope of a cessation of hostilities on the part of the South-
erners, as there is a belief amongst a large part of the
Cantonese Party that Dr. Sun's policy will eventually result
in the breakup of the Cantonese movement. Of the five other
provinces which formerly belonged to the Southern Military
Government, Kwangsi has definitely declared its allegiance
to the Central Government, and it appears as if the election
of Dr. Sun will make Hunan, Yunnan, Kweichow and Szechuen
leave the Southern group.

(The accession of Dr. Sun to the Presidency did not
meet with the approval of a majority of the ex-M. P.s many
of whom are leaving Canton for Shanghai.

由副督察长苏利文撰写，经刑事情报处处长转呈

先生，

尽管南方政府发生了变动，且1920年10月发布了一项总统令宣布南北统一，但和平似乎仍像以往一样遥不可及。

自江苏督军李纯（Li Shun）于1920年10月自杀以来——他在接替王揖唐（Wang Ih Tang）担任北方和平代表后不久自杀，而王揖唐在安福系被直系击败后于1920年8月辞职——中央政府与南方政府的代表之间未举行过任何正式会议。

广州的最新动态是孙中山博士当选为所谓“南方共和国”的大总统。许多人，包括有影响力的广东人在内，从中看到了南方停止敌对行动的希望，因为广东派系中的大部分人相信，孙博士的政策最终会导致广东运动的瓦解。在前南方军政府所属的其他五个省份中，广西已明确宣布效忠中央政府，看来孙中山博士的当选将使湖南、云南、贵州和四川脱离南方集团。

（孙中山博士就任大总统并未获得多数前国会议员的认可，其中许多人正离开广州前往上海。

There is little doubt that the Southern Party are desperately in want of money and since the Diplomatic Corps in Peking have refused to grant them a share of the Customs Surplus, and, owing to Dr. Sun's exploiting of the two principal sources of revenue to wit the mint and the railways, both have ceased to work, so that there is not much prospect of the financial situation there being remedied.

The Southern Army is declared to be formed largely of bandits and robbers, and taken altogether the inhabitants are believed to be tired of the continued unsettled state of the province and many believe that Dr. Sun will be forced to leave Canton eventually. Should this happen and the Southern Army be disbanded in consequence, some of the disbanded soldiers will no doubt come north and a resuscitation of armed robberies and crimes of violence may be expected in Shanghai.

The activities of Baron Ungern's army in Northern Mongolia where, acting in conjunction with Mongols, the capital town, Urga, has been occupied, although directed against the Bolshevistic Far Eastern Republican Government, whose headquarters are at Chita, is causing much anxiety to the Central Government who are being continually bombarded with telegrams etc. urging that the Russians be driven out of Mongolia. There appears now to be a good prospect of the Central Government and the Mongolian Government settling their differences and the latter may then be able to recover

毫无疑问，南方党派极度缺乏资金。由于北京的外交团拒绝给予他们关余份额，加之孙博士榨取造币厂和铁路这两大主要收入来源，导致两者均停止运作，因此那里的财务状况改善的前景渺茫。

据说南方军队主要由匪徒和强盗组成，总体而言，居民被认为已厌倦该省持续的动荡状态，许多人相信孙博士最终将被迫离开广州。如果发生这种情况并因此解散南方军队，部分遣散士兵无疑会北上，预计上海将出现武装抢劫和暴力犯罪的死灰复燃。

恩琴男爵（Baron Ungern）的军队在外蒙古的活动，虽然针对的是总部设在赤塔的布尔什维克远东共和国政府，并与蒙古人联合占领了首都库伦（Urga），但这引起了中央政府的极大焦虑，中央政府不断收到电报等，敦促将俄国人赶出蒙古。目前看来，中央政府与蒙古政府解决分歧的前景良好，后者随后或许能够收回

The drought in North China and rumours which have been current recently that some able soldiers and politicians are planning to restore the monarchy, together with Bolshevist activities all over the country all combine to increase the difficulties of the Central Government, and incidentally to upset business and cause unrest and unemployment in Shanghai. The Central Government is also very short of funds, though not so much so as their opponents in the South, and the strike of professors and educationalists in Peking is purely a result of not receiving their salaries and money for the expenses of the universities.
The Central Government, however, although hard put to it to raise funds, appear to be desirous of falling in with the interests of business people as far as possible, as exemplified by the cancellation of the suggested Customs surtax for famine relief on condition that an agreed sum was raised by voluntary contribution, and of the suggested Stamp Duty in the Foreign Settlements.
There seems to be very little grounds for the rumour that an attempted restoration of the monarchy was contemplated and a well known Monarchist, who was believed to be taking part in the restoration, has privately given it as his opinion that the people of China are not yet sufficiently tired of the Republic to attempt to restore a monarchical form of government.

华北地区的干旱，近期流传的一些能干军人和政治家计划恢复君主制的谣言，以及全国各地的布尔什维克活动，都加剧了中央政府的困难，并顺便扰乱了商业，导致上海的不安和失业。中央政府也非常缺乏资金，虽然不像南方的对手那样严重，北京教授和教育家的罢工纯粹是因为未收到薪水和大学经费所致。

然而，中央政府虽然在筹集资金方面处境艰难，但似乎希望尽可能顺应商界人士的利益，例如取消了建议中的用于赈灾的海关附加税，条件是通过自愿捐款筹集商定数额，并取消了建议在外国租界征收的印花税。

关于企图恢复君主制的谣言似乎几乎没有根据，一位被认为参与复辟活动的著名君主主义者私下表示他的看法是，中国人民尚未对共和制感到足够厌倦，以至于尝试恢复君主政体。

The anti-Japanese agitation has almost entirely
disappeared owing, no doubt, to more recent important
happenings and there is every prospect of the Shantung
question being finally settled in a constitutional way.
After the victory of the Chili over the Anfu Party,
a suggestion, the credit for conceiving which is given to
General Wu Pae Fu(吴佩孚), was put forward for the
summoning of a National Citizens Convention to arrange for
the establishment of democratic government in China and the
restoration of internal peace. Opinions were divided as
to the advisability of this course. Those favouring it
argued that it would eliminate militarism and ensure popular
rule, while those opposed claimed that the mass of people are
too ignorant of Republicanism to take any part in the
Convention.
Eventually the National Citizens Convention Organi-
zation was formed to which several powerful local societies
and guilds became affiliated, but other local societies
including the Students Unions opposed it with the result
that although the first few meetings of the Organization were
very enthusiastic it has now become practically dormant.
The peacefulness of otherwise of this part of the
country depends to a considerable extent on the maintenance
of a plentiful supply of rice, and if the Central Government
and local Chinese Authorities would use the powers at their
command to ensure that no more than can reasonably be spared

在直系击败安福系之后，有人提出召开国民大会的建议，这一构想归功于吴佩孚将军（General Wu Pae Fu），旨在安排在中国建立民主政府并恢复内部和平。对于这一做法的适宜性，意见不一。支持者认为这将消除军阀主义并确保民治，而反对者则声称广大民众对共和主义知之甚少，无法参与大会。

最终成立了国民大会组织，几个强大的地方社团和行会加入其中，但包括学生在内的其他一些地方社团表示反对，结果虽然该组织最初的几次会议非常热烈，但现在实际上已处于停滞状态。

该国这一地区的和平与否在很大程度上取决于维持充足的稻米供应，如果中央政府和地方中国当局利用其掌握的权力，确保不超过合理可调配的数量

自1921年1月1日以来从上海看当地局势。

MEMORANDUM.

Political Situation as seen from Shanghai
since January 1, 1921.

Despite changes which have taken place in the
Southern Government, and a Presidential Mandate
issued in October 1920 declaring the unification
of the North and South peace seems to be almost
as far off as ever.
Since the late Li Shun, Tuchun of Kiangsu,
committed suicide in October 1920 a short time
after his appointment as Northern Peace Delegate
in succession to Wang Ih Tang (王揖唐) who gave
up his post in August 1920 after the defeat of
the Anfu Party by the Chilitics, no formal
meeting between representatives of the Central
and Southern Governments have been held.
The latest development in Canton is the
election of Dr. Sun Yat-sen as President of the
so-called Southern Republic and in this, many
hope of a cessation of hostilities on the
part of the Southerners, as there is a belief
amongst a large part of the Cantonese Party
that Dr. Sun's policy will eventually result
in the breakup of the Cantonese movement. Of
the five other provinces which formerly
belonged to the Southern Military Government,
Kwangsi has definitely declared its allegiance
to the Central Government, and it appears as
if the election of Dr. Sun will make Hunan,
Yunnan, Kweichow and Szechuen leave the Southern
group. The accession of Dr. Sun to the
